issues.title: Hero image is lazy-loaded

chain.label: LCP 13 s
chain.detail: Time until the main content is visible

chain.label: src/components/HeroBanner.tsx:5

issues.why: loading="lazy" tells the browser to wait before downloading the image. For the biggest image on screen that delays the moment the page looks loaded.

steps: Remove loading="lazy" from the hero image
Add fetchpriority="high" so it downloads first
Preload it in <head> if it is always on the page

issues.title: Third-party script loads synchronously
issues.plain: An outside script (analytics / tag manager) holds up the page

chain.label: TBT 0 ms
chain.detail: Time the page is too busy to respond while loading

chain.label: gtm.js
chain.detail: 88 KB, starts at 0 ms, third party

chain.label: index.html:8
chain.detail: <script src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id=GTM-DEMO123">

issues.why: A <script> without async or defer stops HTML parsing until it has downloaded and run. Tag managers then load more scripts on top.

steps: Add async (or defer) to the script tag
Load it after the page is interactive
Review which tags really need to run on every page

issues.title: Too much JavaScript on the page
issues.plain: The page downloads a lot of code before it can work

chain.label: JS 1.9 MB
chain.detail: Amount of JavaScript downloaded and run

issues.why: Every kilobyte of JavaScript must be downloaded, parsed and run on the main thread before the page becomes usable.

steps: Split code per route (dynamic imports)
Replace heavy libraries
Remove unused code with the coverage tab

issues.title: Effect starts setInterval without cleanup
issues.plain: A background task keeps running after you leave the page

chain.label: Memory 9 MB
chain.detail: Memory the page keeps using over time

chain.label: src/components/LiveStock.tsx:8

issues.why: setInterval / addEventListener / subscriptions created in useEffect keep running after the component unmounts unless the effect returns a cleanup. Each visit adds another one, so the app gets slower and heavier over time.

gain.note: memory and INP after long sessions

steps: Return a cleanup function from the effect
Clear the interval / remove the listener / close the socket in it

issues.title: WebSocket reconnects instantly without backoff
issues.plain: When the live connection drops, the app hammers the server trying to reconnect

chain.label: Reconnects 1
chain.detail: How often the live connection drops and reconnects

chain.label: src/lib/socket.ts:11

issues.why: Reconnecting immediately in onclose creates a storm of connections when the server is down or restarting. It floods the server and keeps the browser busy.

gain.note: server load and INP during outages

steps: Wait before reconnecting: delay = min(30 s, 500 ms × 2^attempt) + random jitter
Reset the attempt counter after a successful open
Stop after N attempts and show a "reconnect" button

issues.title: 4 AI steps awaited in sequence
issues.plain: The app waits for several AI steps in a row instead of at the same time

chain.label: First token 2.4 s
chain.detail: Time until the first word of an AI answer appears

chain.label: 4 sequential steps in answerSupportQuestion()
chain.detail: each waits for the previous

chain.label: src/server/rag.ts:28

issues.why: Each awaited call waits for the previous one. Independent calls (embedding + search + lookups) can run in parallel with Promise.all, cutting seconds off every answer.

steps: Find awaited calls that do not depend on each other
Run them with Promise.all([...])
Keep dependent calls sequential

changes.before:
const vector = await embed(question)
const chunks = await searchChunks(vector)
changes.after:
const [r1, r2] = await Promise.all([
  embed(question),
  searchChunks(vector)
])

issues.title: Long system prompt sent uncached every call
issues.plain: The same long instructions are paid for again on every request

chain.label: First token 2.4 s
chain.detail: Time until the first word of an AI answer appears

chain.label: system prompt ~9,800 tokens
chain.detail: sent uncached on every call

chain.label: src/server/rag.ts:28
chain.detail: const vector = await embed(question)

issues.why: A long system prompt or document set is re-processed on every call. Prompt caching lets the provider reuse it, cutting first-token time and cost by half or more.

steps: Mark the stable prefix as cacheable (cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } on Anthropic; prefix caching is automatic on OpenAI when the prefix is stable)
Put the stable part first and the changing part last

issues.title: API response is never cached
issues.plain: The same data is fetched from the server on every visit

chain.label: TTFB 150 ms
chain.detail: Time until the server starts answering

chain.label: json() handler
chain.detail: 105 ms

chain.label: src/server/api/products.ts:22
chain.detail: res.end(JSON.stringify(body))

issues.why: Without Cache-Control every visit waits for the server and database again, even when the data has not changed.

steps: Add a Cache-Control header (e.g. s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate)
Use the framework’s revalidate option for static data
Keep no-store only for personal data

issues.title: Image without width and height
issues.plain: A picture makes the page jump when it appears

chain.label: CLS 0.11
chain.detail: How much the page jumps around while loading

chain.label: src/components/ProductCard.tsx:10

issues.why: Without width and height the browser does not reserve space, so content below jumps down when the image arrives.

steps: Add width and height matching the real image ratio
Keep CSS max-width: 100% so it still scales

issues.title: Text files served without compression
issues.plain: Scripts and styles are sent uncompressed

chain.label: LCP 13 s
chain.detail: Time until the main content is visible

chain.label: client
chain.detail: 176 KB, starts at 170 ms

issues.why: Brotli or gzip typically shrinks JavaScript and CSS by 70%. Without it every visitor downloads several times more.

steps: Enable Brotli/gzip on the server or CDN
Check the Content-Encoding response header

issues.title: Whole date-fns imported
issues.plain: The whole date-fns library (78 KB) is downloaded although only a few functions are used

chain.label: JS 1.9 MB
chain.detail: Amount of JavaScript downloaded and run

chain.label: date-fns
chain.detail: 78 KB

chain.label: src/lib/dates.ts:2
chain.detail: import * as dateFns from 'date-fns'

issues.why: import * as lib (or the default import of moment/lodash) stops the bundler from dropping unused functions, so the whole package ends up in the bundle.

steps: Import only the functions you use
Or switch to a lighter library

issues.title: CartSummary loaded eagerly
issues.plain: The CartSummary code (~63 KB) is downloaded by every visitor although it only shows on demand

chain.label: JS 1.9 MB
chain.detail: Amount of JavaScript downloaded and run

chain.label: CartSummary
chain.detail: 63 KB

chain.label: src/App.tsx:3
chain.detail: import { CartSummary } from './components/CartSummary'

issues.why: The component is only rendered behind a condition (a button, a toggle) but is imported statically, so its code ships with the first load.

steps: Replace the static import with React.lazy(() => import(...)) or next/dynamic
Wrap it in <Suspense> with a small fallback

issues.title: Web font without font-display
issues.plain: Text jumps or stays invisible while the font loads

chain.label: CLS 0.11
chain.detail: How much the page jumps around while loading

chain.label: src/styles/fonts.css:2

issues.why: Without font-display the browser may hide text until the custom font arrives, then swap it with a different size, which shifts the layout.

steps: Add font-display: swap (or optional) to every @font-face
For Google Fonts add &display=swap to the link
Preload the main font file

issues.title: Most of a stylesheet is unused
issues.plain: A 234 KB stylesheet is loaded on every page

chain.label: FCP 11 s
chain.detail: Time until anything appears on screen

chain.label: src/styles/legacy.css
chain.detail: 234 KB, starts at 0 ms

chain.label: src/styles/legacy.css:1
chain.detail: /* Legacy theme: thousands of rules the shop no longer uses. */

issues.why: Stylesheets block rendering until fully downloaded and parsed. Unused rules make that wait longer for nothing.

steps: Split the stylesheet per page or component
Enable CSS purging (Tailwind content, PurgeCSS)
Inline the critical CSS and load the rest later
